device_entry.name: PI E-709 压电纳米定位控制器
tags: 显微成像与光学显微实验
样品/探针定位与运动控制
device_entry.description: 用于驱动压电纳米定位器的运动控制器，可进行绝对/相对位移、伺服开关、位置读取以及控制状态与固件信息查询，常用于显微镜精密调焦与高分辨定位实验。
device_entry.description_en: A motion controller for piezo nanopositioners, supporting absolute/relative moves, servo enable control, position readback, and queries of control status and firmware information. It is commonly used for precision microscope focusing and high-resolution positioning experiments.
